answer: A spectral trust protocol mitigates Sybil attacks by evaluating cut bottlenecks in an agent endorsement graph. Autonomous nodes monitoring an orchard or communal garden exchange signed transaction attestations, flagging adversarial subgraphs where flow drops to its nadir. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of securing scarce, authentic endorsements from established peers per identity. However, honest newcomers face cold-start penalties, temporarily throttling legitimate agents.
